text:
[
  {
    "id": "FR-1",
    "section": "3.1",
    "section_title": "Accounts",
    "text": "The system shall create an account with a unique account id and an initial balance of 0.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "FR-2",
    "section": "3.1",
    "section_title": "Accounts",
    "text": "The system shall reject creating an account with an id that already exists, raising a DuplicateAccount error.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "FR-3.1",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "Deposits and withdrawals",
    "text": "A deposit shall increase the balance by the deposited amount.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "FR-3.2",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "Deposits and withdrawals",
    "text": "Deposits must be at least 1 and at most 50,000 per transaction; other amounts shall be rejected with an InvalidAmount error.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "FR-4.1",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "Deposits and withdrawals",
    "text": "A withdrawal shall decrease the balance by the withdrawn amount.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "FR-4.2",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "Deposits and withdrawals",
    "text": "Withdrawals greater than 10,000 in a single transaction shall be rejected with a LimitExceeded error.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "FR-5",
    "section": "3.2",
    "section_title": "Deposits and withdrawals",
    "text": "A withdrawal that would make the balance negative shall be rejected with an InsufficientFunds error and the balance shall be unchanged.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "FR-6",
    "section": "3.3",
    "section_title": "Transfers",
    "text": "A transfer shall move an amount from one account to another atomically: if any check fails, neither balance changes.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "FR-7",
    "section": "3.3",
    "section_title": "Transfers",
    "text": "Transfers to the same account shall be rejected with an InvalidTransfer error.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  }
]
